ivi.welcome: Hi! I'm iVi for Lesson 15. Ask how to link Why and because.

exercises.explanation: Why do you eat…? I eat… because… Why does she…?

items.label: a
items.original: Por que você come arroz e feijão?
answers: Why do you eat rice and beans?

items.label: b
items.original: Eu como salada porque é saudável.
answers: I eat salad because it is healthy
I eat salad because it is healthy.
I eat salad because it's healthy
I eat salad because it's healthy.

items.label: c
items.original: Por que ela limpa a cozinha agora?
answers: Why does she clean the kitchen now?

items.label: d
items.original: Ela limpa porque tem visita à noite.
answers: She cleans because she has visitors tonight
She cleans because she has visitors tonight.
She cleans because she has a visitor at night

items.label: e
items.original: Por que você pergunta as horas?
answers: Why do you ask the time?
Why do you ask what time it is?
